MADE FOR THE WAY YOU BUILD

Give your next conversation something to work with.

A focused prototype helps you test a useful question instead of trying to build everything at once.

01

Start with one useful journey

Describe who the app is for and the action you want to test. Build the screens that support that path first.

02

See more than the happy path

Explore screens, roles, and dialog states on the canvas. Try the experience with sample data before connecting real users.

03

Turn feedback into a revision

Point to an element, add a visual annotation, and ask for a change. Keep source versions as the idea develops.

BEFORE YOU BEGIN

A few things you might be wondering.

About building prototypes with Atomic.

Is a prototype a finished production app?

No. A prototype helps you explore a design and workflow. Before a real launch, review the generated code, test behaviour and access rules, replace sample content, and check any integrations and data handling.

Can I start with a frontend only?

Yes. Your screens start on sample data, with visual editing, source history, and source downloads. The proposed Free plan adds a backend, database, and authentication for one app; Builder and Pro add them for every app, with collaboration.

Can I try different roles and dialog states?

Yes. Atomic’s canvas supports screen and role previews, including states such as open dialogs. Templates bring sample accounts and records so you can explore a workflow from different perspectives.

Can a developer continue from my prototype?

You can inspect and download the generated source to review or hand off. Downloads do not include app users, business data, or hosting infrastructure. Broader app packaging and deployment choices remain on the roadmap.
